lines: Zindagi jab bhi teri bazm mein laati hai humein
couplets.en: Life keeps bringing me into your company.

lines: Zindagi jab bhi teri bazm mein laati hai humein
Yeh zameen chaand se behtar nazar aati hai humein
couplets.en: Whenever life brings me into your company, the earth looks lovelier than the moon.

lines: Surkh phoolon se mahak uthti hain dil ki raahein
